name: Dry Bones
overview: The topic of 'Dry Bones' in Scripture vividly portrays God's power to bring life from death, as seen in Ezekiel's vision where God commands breath to enter lifeless bones, restoring them to living beings. This imagery echoes the creation of man in Genesis, where God formed man from dust and breathed life into him. It also contrasts the spiritual vitality given by God with the desolation caused by a broken spirit, which Proverbs describes as drying the bones. Together, these verses emphasize God's sovereign ability to revive and sustain life through His Spirit.
